# Elior — Full Reference

> Elior is a premium digital studio based in Volders, Tirol (Austria), founded and led by Thomas Mayrl. Elior builds native iOS/Android apps, custom websites and homepages, and AI/automation solutions. More than 9 apps published on the Apple App Store. This file is the full reference corpus for AI/LLM retrieval.

## About Elior

Elior (elior.studio) is a digital studio in Tirol, Österreich, specializing in:

- Native iOS App Development (Swift, SwiftUI) with AI integration
- Android App Development (native and cross-platform)
- Web Development / Homepage-Programmierung (React, TypeScript, Vite)
- Webdesign Tirol — responsive, SEO-optimized websites
- KI-Integration — OpenAI GPT, DALL·E, computer vision, machine learning
- Automatisierung — workflow and business-process automation

- Region: Tirol, Austria (Österreich)
- Location: Volders, Tirol
- Founder & Developer: Thomas Mayrl
- Website: https://elior.studio
- Email: info@elior.studio
- App Store developer page: https://apps.apple.com/at/developer/thomas-mayrl/id1728579612
- Languages: German (de-AT), English

## Services

### iOS App Entwicklung / App erstellen lassen
Native iPhone and iPad applications built with Swift and SwiftUI. Focus on performance, elegant UI/UX, and App Store Optimization (ASO). Service page: https://elior.studio/app-entwicklung-tirol

### Android App Entwicklung
Native and cross-platform Android app development for businesses in Austria, Germany and Switzerland.

### Web Development / Homepage programmieren
Modern, responsive websites and web applications built with React, TypeScript and Vite. From one-pagers to complex web apps with backend and AI. Homepage erstellen lassen in Tirol und Österreich. Service page: https://elior.studio/webdesign-tirol

### Webdesign Tirol
User-centered design with focus on accessibility, aesthetics, performance and conversion optimization.

### KI-Integration (AI Integration)
Implementation of OpenAI GPT, DALL·E, computer vision and machine-learning capabilities into apps, websites and workflows.

### Automatisierung (Automation)
Workflow automation and business-process automation: connecting tools, automating repetitive tasks, and building AI-driven pipelines for companies.

## Portfolio Apps (iOS)

### 369 — Manifestation App
- Category: Manifestation, Meditation, Wellness, Spiritual
- URL: https://elior.studio/369
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/at/app/369-manifest/id6738690566
- Manifestation app based on Nikola Tesla's 369 method, with AI Vision Boards, daily affirmations, guided meditation, goal tracking and abundance tools.
- Key features: 369 method (morning/afternoon/evening), AI vision boards (text-to-image), AI-personalized meditations, Solfeggio frequencies, 21-day tracking, gratitude journal.
- Best for: people interested in manifestation, law of attraction, affirmations, meditation, spirituality, numerology, vision boards.

### NumiStellar — Astrology & Numerology
- Category: Astrology, Numerology, Cosmic Energy
- URL: https://elior.studio/numistellar
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/at/app/numistellar/id6478859654
- Astrology and numerology app with AI Energy Chat, Angel Numbers, Daily Energy, birth chart analysis, astrocartography, Schumann resonance and cosmic weather.
- Key features: AI Energy Chat, astrocartography, real-time planetary positions, birth chart, Schumann resonance, solar activity, home-screen widgets, angel numbers, horoscopes.
- Best for: astrology, horoscopes, birth charts, cosmic energy, numerology, spiritual guidance.

### kiBook — AI Children's Book Creator
- Category: AI Story Generation, Children's Books, Creative Writing
- URL: https://elior.studio/kibook
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/at/app/kibook-dein-abenteuer/id6744836466
- Turns a child's imagination into illustrated stories. Customize characters, themes and art styles.
- Key features: AI story generation, multiple art styles (watercolor, pencil, 3D cartoon, flat), auto illustrations, personal library, PDF export, kid-safe content.
- Best for: parents, children, educators, families wanting personalized storybooks.

### Elow — AI Music Generator
- Category: AI Music Generation, Soundscapes, Audio Creation
- URL: https://elior.studio/elow
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/at/app/elow/id6742148929
- Transforms emotions and ideas into original soundscapes. "Musik erstellen mit KI".
- Key features: AI song creation from text, mood-based songs, genre mashup (ambient, electronic, lo-fi, cinematic), personal soundtrack, multiple languages, royalty-free output.
- Best for: content creators, focus/study music, meditation, fitness, filmmakers.

### Orbit — Space Arcade Game
- Category: Gaming, Arcade, Space
- URL: https://elior.studio/orbit

### ABWUN — Prayer App
- Category: Prayer, Faith, Christian, Spirituality
- URL: https://elior.studio/abwun
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/abwun/id6810855629
- ABWUN is the opposite of manifestation: a daily path with God in three surrenders (morning, noon, evening), with an AI prayer companion and biblically grounded prayers ending "in Jesus' name". "Trust Him."
- Key features: three daily surrenders; Heart Conversation AI prayer companion (GPT-4o-mini); Prayer Rope (Gebetsschnur) with the Jesus Prayer on 33/50/100 knots and breath mode; full Rosary (Rosenkranz) with all 20 mysteries by weekday and official liturgical wording; The Simple Way (christ-centered path); Lament & Unanswered Prayer (Klage & unbeantwortetes Gebet); The Examen (Ignatian five-step review); Faith & Answers (chat about God, Jesus, Bible, faith); Silence / Lectio Divina.
- Available in German, English, Spanish, Italian, Romanian.
- Best for: Christians seeking prayer guidance, daily devotion, spiritual growth and inner freedom through surrender to God.

### Suremate — Digital Insurance Claims
- Category: Insurance Management, InsurTech
- URL: https://elior.studio/suremate
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/at/app/suremate/id6475345859
- Report car accidents, household damage and personal injury digitally with photos and structured documentation; manage policies.
- Best for: insurance customers wanting digital damage-claim and policy management.

### Suremate Pro — Insurance Agent CRM
- Category: Insurance Agent Tools, B2B
- URL: https://elior.studio/suremate-pro
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/at/app/suremate-pro/id6502916525
- B2B insurance CRM for agents in Austria: customer overview, real-time claim notifications, damage reports, mobile CRM.
- Best for: insurance agents and brokers needing professional client management.

### StradaHub — Community Traffic App
- Category: Traffic, Navigation, Community, Driving
- URL: https://elior.studio/stradahub
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/stradahub/id6796659292
- Community traffic app for the DACH region. Real-time reports of accidents, roadworks, closures, traffic jams, hazards and controls on the map. Free, no registration, no ads. NO speed-camera/radar warnings.
- Best for: commuters and drivers in Austria, Germany and Switzerland.
